PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Shared Sens Essentials configs that Quasar keeps applied on your servers
PluginData.Description:
Shared configs for the Sens Essentials Magnetar plugin, for admins running several servers.
Create named configs on the Sens Essentials page and choose which servers follow each one. Saving a config sends it to every server following it within seconds; servers that are offline get it as soon as they connect. While a server follows a shared config, changes made to Sens Essentials on that server's Plugins page are undone, so the config stays the same everywhere. A config can also be started from the settings of a server you already set up.
The editor has the same tabs as the Torch plugin: General, MOTD, Auto Commands, Sim Speed, Info Commands, Block Presets, Cleanup Presets, Discord Logging, Admin Tools and Instructions, with warnings for items that need attention.
Needs the Sens Essentials Magnetar plugin on the servers. Includes a small companion Magnetar plugin (sensessentials.quasar) that Quasar adds to managed servers; restart servers that were running when this plugin was enabled. Cluster nodes are not managed, a cluster's plugins are configured through the cluster.
